do: Keep views small structs and compose them
dont: Do not build one giant body or use a class for a view

do: Use @State for local state and @Observable (iOS 17 and later) or ObservableObject for shared models
dont: Do not mix three state systems in one screen

do: Use NavigationStack or NavigationSplitView with navigationDestination
dont: Do not use the old NavigationView for new work

do: Use Lazy stacks and List with stable identifiers
dont: Do not use GeometryReader to size everything

do: Support Dynamic Type and add accessibility labels and traits
dont: Do not fix point sizes on text

do: Use withAnimation and respect Reduce Motion
dont: Do not animate on every state change

do: Use the generated dynamic colors and one tint
dont: Do not hard-code hex in a view

do: Keep composables small and pure and pass state down and events up
dont: Do not call a repository or a use case from UI code

do: Hoist state and expose immutable UI state from the view model
dont: Do not store mutable collections in state

do: Use LazyColumn with stable keys
dont: Do not nest scroll containers or use Column for long lists

do: Use MaterialTheme roles and a typography scale and keep a design system
dont: Do not hard-code text styles or colors

do: Use Row and Column and use Box only for overlap and use Modifier before extra layouts
dont: Do not default to fillMaxSize or nest deeply

do: Add semantics and content descriptions and test with testTag
dont: Do not rely on color alone

do: Use the Compose animation APIs and keep animation logic out of the view model
dont: Do not animate in a coroutine you do not cancel

do: Use functional components and TypeScript and keep files near their component
dont: Do not use inline styles for everything

do: Use StyleSheet or the project's styling system and flexbox
dont: Do not mix two styling systems

do: Use the project's router and type the params and support deep links
dont: Do not override Android back except to confirm a discard

do: Use FlatList or a faster list with stable keys and measured rows
dont: Do not map items inside a ScrollView for unbounded data

do: Use Pressable with press feedback and hitSlop for small targets
dont: Do not use plain Touchable for new work

do: Use Reanimated on the UI thread and the gesture handler
dont: Do not drive animation from state set in onScroll

do: Keep Platform differences in tokens and components
dont: Do not scatter Platform checks across screens

do: Pair every iOS shadow with an Android elevation and read colors from roles
dont: Do not set shadowColor alone

do: Prefer stateless widgets and const constructors and keep widgets small
dont: Do not call setState in build

do: Use ThemeData and ColorScheme and read them from context
dont: Do not hard-code colors and do not use legacy accent properties

do: Use Row and Column with Expanded and LayoutBuilder and read constraints
dont: Do not check device type or lock orientation

do: Use ListView.builder and keys for stateful items
dont: Do not build long lists with Column

do: Use a router such as GoRouter and PopScope for back handling
dont: Do not pass untyped arguments

do: Choose implicit then explicit then physics then hero by need and dispose controllers
dont: Do not leak an AnimationController

do: Show scrollbars on desktop and make read-only text selectable and place confirm by OS
dont: Do not ship a phone layout to desktop

do: Add Semantics and support large fonts and test with a screen reader
dont: Do not use tap targets under the platform minimum

do: Keep state small and lift it only when needed and use reducers for complex state
dont: Do not store derived data in state

do: Clean up effects and list real dependencies and avoid effects for derived values
dont: Do not use an effect where an event handler fits

do: Keep components small and compose and type props
dont: Do not drill props through many levels

do: Use semantic HTML and labels and controlled inputs where needed
dont: Do not rely on placeholder as a label

do: Virtualize long lists and lazy load heavy routes and measure before memoizing
dont: Do not memoize everything by habit

do: Manage focus and announce dynamic content
dont: Do not use div as a button

do: Use Server Components by default and push Client Components to the leaves
dont: Do not mark a whole tree as client

do: Fetch on the server and set caching on purpose and validate Server Action input
dont: Do not trust request input

do: Use next/image with dimensions and next/font
dont: Do not cause layout shift

do: Use script setup and the Composition API and define props and emits with types
dont: Do not mutate props

do: Use ref for primitives and computed for derived values and Pinia for shared state
dont: Do not mix v-if with v-for on one element

do: Always give v-for a stable key
dont: Do not use the index as a key for changing lists

do: Use useFetch or useAsyncData and handle loading and error and keep secrets in private config
dont: Do not run side effects at the root of script setup

do: Use routeRules for per-route rendering and client or server suffixes on purpose
dont: Do not read window during server render

do: Use runes in Svelte 5 for state and derived values and effects
dont: Do not add effects for values that can be derived

do: Key every each block
dont: Do not leave keys out of changing lists

do: Use the built-in transitions and give local scope where needed
dont: Do not animate without a reduced motion path

do: Map semantic variables with @theme inline and use role utilities
dont: Do not repeat dark variants per color

do: Extract components and variants and not long class strings
dont: Do not nest theme blocks inside a mode block

do: Use the component variants and compose with className and keep the registry source
dont: Do not fork a primitive for one color

do: Use Field and validation helpers and show errors on the field
dont: Do not hide errors in a toast

do: Use Material components and window insets and sp for text
dont: Do not mix View and Compose theming without a bridge

do: Use system controls and trait collections and Dynamic Type
dont: Do not draw custom controls to match a web design
